exercises.name: push-up
exercises.description: A bodyweight pushing exercise performed in plank position, lowering and raising the torso using the arms.
exercises.rep_definition: One full rep is lowering the chest toward the ground and pressing back up until the arms are fully extended.

exercises.name: squat
exercises.description: A lower-body movement involving bending the knees and hips to lower the body, then returning to standing.
exercises.rep_definition: One full rep is standing upright, lowering the hips to at least parallel with the knees, and returning to standing.

exercises.name: deadlift
exercises.description: A compound lift where a barbell or weight is lifted from the floor to hip height by extending the hips and knees.
exercises.rep_definition: One full rep is lifting the weight from the floor to a fully upright standing position, then returning it to the floor.

exercises.name: bicep curl
exercises.description: An isolation exercise where weight is curled upward by flexing the elbow, targeting the biceps.
exercises.rep_definition: One full rep is arms extended at the sides, curling the weight up toward the shoulders, and lowering back to full extension.

exercises.name: lunge
exercises.description: A lower-body exercise where one leg steps forward and bends while the rear knee lowers toward the ground.
exercises.rep_definition: One full rep is stepping forward into a lunge position with the rear knee lowering, then returning to standing. Each leg counts as one rep.

exercises.name: pull-up
exercises.description: An upper-body exercise where the body is pulled upward on a bar until the chin clears the bar.
exercises.rep_definition: One full rep is hanging with arms extended, pulling up until the chin is above the bar, and lowering back to full arm extension.

exercises.name: shoulder press
exercises.description: A pressing movement where weight is pushed overhead from shoulder height to full arm extension.
exercises.rep_definition: One full rep is pressing the weight from shoulder level to full lockout overhead, then lowering back to shoulder level.

exercises.name: sit-up
exercises.description: A core exercise where the torso is raised from a lying position toward the knees and then lowered back.
exercises.rep_definition: One full rep is lying flat on the back, raising the torso toward the knees, and lowering back to the starting position.

exercises.name: hip adduction
exercises.description: A lower-body isolation movement where the legs are brought together toward the midline, typically on a machine or with a cable or band.
exercises.rep_definition: One full rep is starting with legs apart in the working range, squeezing the legs together through full adduction, then returning to the start position.
